name: Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 works, but is compile-ahead - not load-a-GGUF
symptom: Everything is quantized-compile-ahead (AWQ-INT4/mxfp6 via quic/efficient-transformers -> QPC): there is no 'load a GGUF and go' path.
root_cause: The public cloud-ai-sdk (BSD-3) vLLM container ghcr.io/quic/cloud_ai_inference_vllm runs Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4 out of the box, and third parties have run 70B (DemoAIExperience) and Qwen3-30B on 4x cards (chihaoy) - but it needs the QAic platform SDK installed and a compile-and-serve pipeline.
workaround: The SDK is real and public - viable for someone who wants the journey. Sweet spot for a single 32GB card is 7-8B INT4; single-card decode tok/s is not cleanly published.
notes: Verdict 'viable-ish / expert trap': if you can't drive a compile-and-serve QPC pipeline it becomes a paperweight.
